summary: Prompts to start from, as raised keys that press in: a row of chips, or a grid of cards for an empty chat.

props.name: onSelect
props.description: Called with the picked suggestion, such as to fill the prompt.

props.name: variant
props.description: A row of chips that scrolls sideways, or a grid of cards for an empty chat.

props.name: shape
props.description: Corner radius of the chips or cards. Inherits the nearest `Shape`.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes. `merge` folds them in last, so one here replaces the component's own class for the same utility.

props.name: focus
props.description: The focus outline. `true` draws it, `false` removes it, and a string of Yumma CSS utilities restyles it on every focusable part of the component, which is more than `className` reaches. Removing it outright and putting nothing back fails WCAG 2.4.7.
